data.narrative:
Marvel Fusion is a Series B nuclear energy company that has raised $400M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers: 3 public entities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy. However, the narrow peer set—only one same-stage comparable and one adjacent-stage peer—precluded a robust median peer multiple approach.

Stage-progression analysis, the primary applicable method, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $400M raised baseline, yielding $760M. This represents the median of the triangulated range. The low and high bounds ($646M and $874M) reflect reasonable variance around this central estimate given the single-method dependency and the nascent state of commercial nuclear technology deployment.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $646M to $874M, with $760M as the point estimate. Key uncertainties center on the scarcity of direct-stage comparables in nuclear energy—a sector with few publicly traded peers and a fragmented private landscape—and the absence of standardized revenue or deployment metrics across this cohort. Further validation would benefit from density data on capital intensity and time-to-commercialization across the peer set once additional companies mature toward exit.
